tagline: Commissioner, negotiator, and two perfect lineups with nothing to show.
file: A commissioner who competes, and a competitor who negotiates in public. Every roster move comes with an audience.
Naming a price in the chat, then renegotiating it live. Swift for next year's 1st, Collins on the block, and Achane staying in the IR slot till next year.
The ceiling. Perfect lineups in Weeks 4 and 5, 118.36 and 140.36, lost by 65.06 and 23.2.
Whether the block becomes a trade before the deadline, and a FAAB budget that is down to $104.

2026.headline: Two perfect lineups, two losses, and the 1.01 by 7.06
story: The draft set the tone. Darkspaces cut the pick timer to a minute, loaded up on receivers, and handed nicknames to twenty-three of his own players, then spent the first waiver run buying a tight end he had not drafted for $101 and Singleton for $301 on top of it. That is $402 gone before the first Monday night, and the wallet is down to $104.

The pattern since is spend big, sell high, talk loudly. Deebo Samuel went to Snipe58 for a 2027 2nd, Colston Loveland went for Jake Ferguson, and Matthew Stafford went to the same buyer for two future 2nds and $100 of FAAB. Week 5 brought no trade, only talk: Zygon asked about Achane, Darkspaces said Achane is going to sit in his IR slot, and the commissioner roasted himself in the chat before anyone else could.

The record is 2-3, ninth in the standings. Drake Maye was the QB of the week at 39.46 and Darkspaces set a perfect lineup, 140.36 with nothing left on the bench, and still lost by 23.2 to Johnny4Skins. It is his second perfect lineup in a row and his second loss. The 649.28 MAXPF is the lowest in the league, which holds the 1.01 by 7.06 points over Snipe58. The commissioner wrote the rule and is leading the race it created.
takes: The negotiation is the content, and the roast is the encore.
